document: Mobile Explore visibility and final content cleanup, before expert review.
statusBasis: All acceptance criteria A-J pass. Every narrow-layout result is viewport emulation in one desktop Chrome; no real phone or tablet was used.
publicRelease: NOT CLAIMED. This build is not public-release ready.

acceptance.A_targetClearlyVisibleAt390And412: pass - every exploration's target is fully above the panel; target height 2.0-2.3x what it was
acceptance.B_panelNeverCoversTarget: pass - 0 % covered in 36 of 36 width x exploration cases and in 64 of 64 state frames
acceptance.C_targetInteractable: pass - the grip point reaches the canvas in every case; a real drag starting on the target moves it at 390, 412 and 1280
acceptance.D_noWholeBodyMovementRegression: pass - 0 context groups and 0 camera movement from a target drag
acceptance.E_noNarrationRegression: pass - one clip regenerated, 75 reused; ownership, sync and stale-narration suites pass
acceptance.F_unsourcedFreestJointClaimRemoved: pass - narr.ball.move rewritten; 0 strings or clips carry a comparative claim
acceptance.H_productionAssetsByteIdentical: pass - 29/29 frozen files; master matches its pin; asset directories unchanged
acceptance.I_validatedElbowUnchanged: pass - 0/45/90/145 exact; assets byte-identical; DOF, range, axis, pivot and neutral untouched
acceptance.J_expertReviewPending: pass - every item PENDING; new package in qa/expert/step16e/

rootCause: The composition reserved a fixed 40 % of a narrow screen for an open panel; the top bar, the panel and the 244 px player actually took 68-78 % at 390x844, so the joint site was projected inside the panel.
The composition shrank the subject by the reserved fraction whichever side it had been fitted to; in portrait the fit is width-limited, so the x0.6 shrink bought no clearance.

three.js setViewOffset sets camera.aspect = fullWidth / fullHeight. The old offset's taller virtual frame turned a 0.46 aspect into 0.33 before the exploration's framing was computed, so the camera stood 1.39x further back than the framing asked for.

chosen: A - on narrow layouts the paused film's player steps aside and the panel takes its place
C - the subject is composed into the band the panel actually leaves, measured from the panel's own rectangle
B (minimal) - the elbow's duplicate angle is visually hidden on narrow layouts; portrait tablets lay the same panel out in two columns

rejected.D_collapseWhileDragging: not needed once A + C clear the target in every state; would add motion and a hidden-content state

solution.cameraDistance: unchanged on desktop; on a phone back to the fit the exploration's own sphere asks for (e.g. 3.185 -> 2.284 at 390x844), never tighter than the reviewed desktop framing
solution.deliveryBounds: framing spheres, exploration scales, manifests and GLBs unchanged

measurements.coveredAfter: 0 % at every required width, every exploration, every state

content.old: That one joint gives the arm more freedom than any other in the body: forward, backwards, out sideways, and right round.
content.new: From this one joint, the arm can move in many directions: forward, backwards, out sideways, and right round.

tests.earlierRun: 115 passed, 1 failed: step14-a11y found 'Return to the lesson' at 1.27:1 on a phone - a latent hover-contrast defect this step's layout exposed; fixed, then the whole suite re-run

performance.audioBeforeFirst3DKB: 36 / 8 - the first clip's prefetch races the first frame on both builds
performance.timings: not reported: this machine's CPU benchmark drifts ~4x between sessions

leftAlone: Shot composition during the film (composeLift 0.28/0.40) has the same aspect side-effect as the old explore composition. It governs all 52 mobile shots and is outside this brief.
The recall panel keeps the old composition; it is not an Explore task.
In the fixed exploration the task ('Try to move the two skull bones apart.') and the instruction ('Try to move the skull bones.') are near-duplicates on screen; content, left for the expert review.
On desktop, 'Return to the lesson' still appears twice while an exploration is open (panel and player toggle); on a phone it now appears once.
